investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin outperforms equities (BTC > SPY on % return basis) through Q4 2026 as El Salvador IMF success validates sovereign crypto adoption, Fed easing erodes USD confidence, and supply shock (mining halving legacy + institutional hoarding) tightens liquidity.
supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: $600K BTC price target credibility in current cycle commentary.
CoinDesk: El Salvador IMF Bitcoin waivers granted (institutional legitimacy inflection).
CNBC: Trump midterm dividend pledges + potential Senate flip create fiscal stimulus narrative favoring non-fiat assets.
Crypto job postings tripled; institutional dealmaking pipeline robust despite regulatory stalls.
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed rate cuts may take longer than priced; geopolitical risk (Iran/Ukraine escalation) drives USD bid, suppressing BTC correlation benefit. El Salvador IMF approval may be one-off, not systemic shift.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perps or BTC/USD spot with SPY short or neutral hedge; or BTC/SPY ratio trade (long BTC, short SPY equal dollar value).

investment_theses.thesis: Ethereum underperforms Bitcoin (ETH/BTC ratio contracts) through Q3 2026 as AI agent infrastructure (Cathie Wood signal) consolidates on L1 chains and layer-2 scaling remains fragmented; tokenization (BlackRock narrative) benefits custodial solutions, not general ETH price.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Cathie Wood explicitly flagging AI agent spending behavior as alpha signal; infrastructure optimization (HN: Homa protocol for AI clusters) favors BTC/L1 efficiency.
BlackRock tokenization: requires custody/settlement infrastructure, not necessarily ETH gas demand.
Crypto product retention struggles signal user migration away from Ethereum-native DeFi toys toward custody.
investment_theses.counter_view: Layer-2 fee compression (Aerodrome trending) could drive ETH demand spike. Tokenization narrative may specifically require Ethereum security model, reversing underperformance.
investment_theses.expression: Short ETH/BTC ratio via perpetuals (sell ETH, buy BTC equal notional); or sell ETH against BTC outright.

investment_theses.thesis: US dollar weakens vs. emerging market currencies and crypto through H2 2026 as Fed cuts rates aggressively (political pressure from Trump dividend pledges + Gen Z debt stress signals), geopolitical fragmentation drives reserve diversification (Russia digital ruble, El Salvador Bitcoin precedent), and inflation expectations shift.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Trump reiterating $5,000 dividend pledge contingent on GOP Congress; midterm political pressure for fiscal expansion.
Cointelegraph: Russia Finance Ministry wages in digital rubles; El Salvador IMF approval validates sovereignty-level crypto adoption.
CoinDesk: Clarity Act stall but crypto dealmaking pipeline intact; institutional confidence in parallel currency rails building.
BBC/CNBC: Geopolitical escalation (Iran naval strikes, Ukraine bridge attacks, Yemen war declaration) creates reserve currency fragmentation incentive.
investment_theses.counter_view: US equities (SPY, NVDA) remain safe-haven bid. Fed may resist aggressive cuts if inflation stays sticky. Treasury curve inversion unwinds faster than expected, strengthening USD.
investment_theses.expression: Long DXY put spreads or short DXY outright; long BTC and ETH as USD hedge; long emerging market currency ETFs (EEM) or commodity-linked instruments (gold, USO).

investment_theses.thesis: Gen Z-focused betting and engagement platforms (implied by Novig surge post-Sydney Sweeney campaign) face regulatory headwinds and mental health litigation risk; financial stress from sports betting as pseudo-investment may accelerate credit card delinquencies and reduce discretionary spending (negative for consumer ETFs) through 2026.

Novig 'Just Sports' campaign drew backlash from athletes but drove trading volume spike (sustainability questionable).
